title: Public integrity — documented cases and court records
scope: Curated U.S. federal, state and local public-integrity investigations with court or DOJ records; non-exhaustive, not a representative sample.
publication_rule: A named individual appears only when an official public source identifies their role. Conviction, plea, charge and being named in evidence are different statuses. An indictment is an allegation, not proof of guilt.
